## Summary

Briefly describe the change and why it is needed.

## Related issue

Closes #N (or links to the issue this PR addresses).

## Change type

Please check at least one:

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change that fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change that adds functionality)
- [ ] Documentation / DX (README, docs, templates, contributing guidance)
- [ ] Security (see SECURITY.md before opening)
- [ ] Refactor / test / CI

## Checklist

- [ ] I read CONTRIBUTING.md and followed the workflow.
- [ ] I opened an issue first for larger changes.
- [ ] `make check` (ruff, black, mypy, pytest) passes locally.
- [ ] Tests are included for new behavior, or I explained why none apply.
- [ ] Documentation (README / docs / SECURITY.md) was updated when behavior changed.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or real recipient data are included.
- [ ] The commit message references the issue (`Closes #N`).

## Screenshots / output

Paste relevant terminal output, logs, or screenshots, with credentials redacted.
